skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button. If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. If the charge has finished, you will unleash a different attack. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Not Charged: A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.

Charged: Increases own ATK. An extra long-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
skills.name: Strike of the Blue

skills.detail: A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect. When attacking an enemy with 70% or more of their max HP remaining, deals an additional amount of fixed damage. This will deal a fixed amount of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
